name: Expert Poisoner
body:
Your skill with your own poison is unparalleled.

Prerequisite: Poison gland racial trait, wyvaran

Benefit: The DC of your poison increases by +2, and you are no longer at risk to accidentally poison yourself when you apply your own poison to a weapon.
